name: v1.0.0 — packaged auto-hide helper
body:
First packaged release of **Coucou auto-hide**.

A Windows helper that slides the Coucou overlay behind the top screen edge and
brings it back when the pointer touches that edge. It moves Coucou's own window
with `SetWindowPos` — no Coucou code is copied, patched or bundled.

**Asset:** `coucou-autohide-1.0.0.zip` — `coucou-autohide.ps1`,
`run-coucou-autohide.cmd`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`.

Requires Windows 10/11, PowerShell 5.1, and Coucou for Windows running.
Double-click `run-coucou-autohide.cmd`, or run the script with
`-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`. Unblock the zip after downloading if Windows marks it
as from the internet.
